verdict.rationale: The docs describe a customization layer for storefront code: the Storefront theme exposes many add_action() hooks for inserting HTML, PHP and JavaScript into its core templates, and Purple is described as a block theme with modern templates. Nothing shows a local storefront preview workflow or version-controlled theme deploys. The Storybook integration and the repo build instructions cover extension and core development, not storefront theme previewing. Missing for 10: documented local preview/dev environment for themes, version-controlled theme deploy workflow, an in-depth templating reference beyond hooks, independent hands-on corroboration.
